author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Get incredible terrain for your own battles from our sponsor! Use code PLAYON26 (expires April 19) for 20% off Hextech or Mundus Imperialis Epic Scale Gothic terrain https://www.battlefrontgroup.com/battlefield-in-a-box

JT plays his all-time favourite game! Let us know what you thought, leave a comment or like so we know whether we should greenlight a full series.

Play On Tabletop in collaboration with Visionary Production & Design Inc. present an immersive Battletech Alpha Strike engagement that is a treat for fans of the universe. This is our love letter to a game very close to JT's heart. 

The Clans launch Wave One of OPERATION REVIVAL, the invasion of the Inner Sphere. Dozens of worlds are caught in our overwhelming military might. System after system fall to our invasion from beyond the Rim as the Inner Sphere scrambles desperately tries to turn the tide.

In The Edge system, Clan Wolf launched their strike from the Periphery into Rasalhague. The 16th Battle Cluster Rasalhague
title: Battletech Alpha Strike Pilot Episode! JT plays his all time favourite game
